I could not falsify this artifact. It delivers the approved plan and its checks bite.

The six-path write-set is exactly what landed (execution-000019), in exactly one conventional commit with no footer (execution-000020), no tag (execution-000022), no version/pyproject/uv.lock/contract/typecheck-fixture/test_map_stations change (execution-000021), no new noqa/type-ignore/marker/skip (execution-000024), and pr-body.md untracked with the worktree tracked-clean (execution-000023). Full suite: 1660 passed, 2 skipped (execution-000008), matching acceptance criterion 8; the two skips are the untouched missing-folium ones (they sit at tests/test_map_stations.py:279/:290, not the 179/190 my instructions quoted -- the file is unmodified here, so those line numbers are stale, not a defect). ruff format --check, ruff check, and ty check src are green and src-scoped (execution-000025/000026/000027).

Every acceptance criterion is backed by an assertion I proved can detect its own violation, in a scratch copy outside the worktree whose venv I repointed at the scratch source so mutations actually take effect (verified by execution-000007). Inverting the boundary conversion reddens four tests (execution-000006); hard-coding RawMode.OMIT reddens the two raw=True tests (execution-000009); tampering the retained bytes or the retained origin inside driver.drive reddens them too (execution-000030, execution-000033) -- so raw=True really pins the exact Payload.content object and its exact SourceCallOrigin handed to parse, and raw=False really yields no receipts. Applying the policy per series as well as on the merged result IS caught: the exact two-element warning list and the raise test both redden (execution-000010), so a regression to warn-once-per-series would not slip through. Dropping one series' issues at the merge reddens all four policy tests (execution-000011). Pinning the policy to any constant reddens the tests for the other two policies (execution-000012/000013/000014), and the signature/annotation assertions redden on a changed default or a changed annotation (execution-000036/000037/000038). I also went past the plan and authored my own probe file to check the mirrored behaviour on fetch_by_provider that the plan does not test: default warn emits one warning per actionable issue per partition, raise refuses with the exact text, ignore is silent, raw=False yields empty entries (execution-000035, 3 passed). The one asymmetry I found -- raise on fetch_by_provider short-circuits later partitions -- is the direct consequence of the edit the plan itself prescribes and is pinned by no criterion, so I report it as an observation, not a break.

RawMode is absent from dir(rivretrieve) yet importable and live internally (execution-000015), and re-adding the root export reddens test_package (execution-000016); deleting a legacy name reddens it too (execution-000017), so all seven m9-owned names are genuinely fenced. No pre-existing assertion was weakened: the only removals are the two now-false absence checks and the identity check the plan replaces with a stronger absence-plus-internal-members trio, and the fixture origin change strengthens the raw evidence. Every measurable pr-body claim reproduced under my own measurement. I raise no blocking issue.
